person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: whether a network can be made to find the organ it is supposed to measure, instead of being handed a cropped region by a second network trained to find it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: whether a soft attention gate inside a single CNN can replace the cascade - a localisation model followed by a segmentation model - without losing accuracy or adding many parameters
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a grid-based additive attention gate that drops into VGG or U-Net, learns where to look with no bounding boxes and no extra supervision, improves recall and precision on CT pancreas segmentation and fetal ultrasound plane detection, and is shown to beat simply making the baseline bigger
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: method
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: small, variable-shaped structures that a single-stage network misses, and the cascades built to hand it a cropped view of them - which repeat the same low-level features in every model of the chain
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: attention coefficients computed from a coarse gating signal and a finer feature map, applied multiplicatively, trained end-to-end with deep supervision at each scale; evaluated on two CT abdominal datasets and a 190k-frame ultrasound set
span.term: attention coefficients computed from a coarse gating signal and a finer feature map, applied multiplicatively, trained end-to-end with deep supervision at each scale; evaluated on two CT abdominal datasets and a 190k-frame ultrasound set
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a cascade spends a whole network learning where the organ is and then throws that network's features away; a gate computes the same decision from features the predictor already has, so the localisation costs 8% more parameters instead of a second model, and the low-level features are extracted once
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the gating parameters start so that every feature vector passes at every location - the network begins as its own baseline and has to learn to suppress, which is why no multi-stage training schedule is needed and why any difference is attributable to what the gate learned rather than to where it started
span.term: a gate initialised to do nothing
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the gating signal is taken from a coarser grid, where the receptive field is large enough to know where the organ is, and applied to a finer map, where the resolution is enough to draw its boundary - which is the same division of labour a cascade makes between its two networks, done inside one
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: softmax over the attention map produces sparse, intensity-sensitive attention, which is bad in ultrasound; sigmoid only rescales and lets more information through, and pays for it with gradient saturation. Neither is free and the paper reports both costs
span.term: a normalisation choice that trades sparsity against gradients
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the attention map outlines the discriminant region and does not necessarily coincide with the entire object, so it localises without delineating
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the comparison against 2D cascaded state-of-the-art models is called insufficient to draw a final conclusion, because the 3D model has context and the 2D models have resolution
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: softmax normalisation gives sparse, intensity-sensitive maps and sigmoid gives gradient saturation - the normalisation choice has no free option
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: training the attention mechanism is more complex than the baseline, and the most stable route was per-scale training followed by fine-tuning
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: residual connections around the gate gave no significant improvement in the segmentation experiments
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: additive soft attention, carried from sentence-to-sentence machine translation into a convolutional network over medical images, and re-based on an image grid so the coefficients can be local
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: higher-capacity U-Net models trained and compared against the smaller gated model, rather than only against the same-size baseline
span.note: eliminates: the extra parameters as the explanation of the gain - a module that adds 8% capacity and improves DSC by 2-3% has to be shown to beat 8% more capacity spread uniformly, and it does at p = .007 · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the same two models retrained at a smaller training size (30 images instead of 120)
span.note: eliminates: the improvement being an artefact of one data budget - if attention only helps when data is plentiful it is not solving the localisation problem it claims to · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: models trained on CT-150 applied directly to the public CT-82 benchmark with no fine-tuning, before any adaptation is done
span.note: eliminates: the result being tied to one institution's data - the transfer is measured before the models are allowed to see the new distribution · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: both models also trained from scratch on 61 CT-82 images, in addition to the fine-tuned and directly-applied conditions
span.note: eliminates: pre-training on the private dataset as a hidden advantage in the public benchmark comparison · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: 5-fold cross-validation on CT-82 with the Attention U-Net, reported with its standard deviation
span.note: eliminates: a single favourable train/test split - the spread of 6.23 DSC is the size of the effect being claimed, and reporting it makes that visible · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: conditional random field post-processing deliberately NOT applied, and said so, although the comparison methods use it
span.note: eliminates: post-processing absorbing or masking the gate's contribution - the measured difference is the module's in an isolated setting, at the cost of a lower absolute number · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: ultrasound frames cropped to the central 208 x 272 so the network cannot read the annotations the scanner prints around the image
span.note: eliminates: the network reading the annotations the scanner prints around the image instead of the anatomy - a leak that would look like accuracy · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: gating parameters initialised so that the gates pass every feature vector at every location, making the network start as its own baseline
span.note: eliminates: that the attention gates help only because they change the initialisation - starting open makes the network its own baseline at step zero · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: class imbalance handled by weighted sampling for classification and a Dice loss for segmentation, in both the attention and the baseline networks
span.note: eliminates: the dominant background class carrying the score, and any difference between the two networks being a difference in how each one met the imbalance · outcome: held
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
